You’re not stuck and your child can still ride safely.Here’s the quick breakdown:• This ONLY affects the SnugRide Turn & Slide• No other Graco SnugRide or rotating seats are included• Stop using the base• You can still use the seat WITHOUT the base (seat belt install)• Graco will send you a free replacementWhat to do next:➡️Stop using the base➡️Install without the base➡️Register on Graco’s recall site➡️Follow their steps ➡️Choose your replacement seatI know recalls feel scary but this is how the system is supposed to work.
